description: This file defines the UploadState class used to manage and track the state of a multipart upload in the AWS SDK for PHP, including upload ID, part size, uploaded parts, and status.
external_files: Namespace Aws" (for organization within the SDK, but no external file dependencies explicitly imported in this snippet)

classes.name: UploadState
classes.description: Represents and manages the state of a multipart upload, including tracking uploaded parts, upload status, and parameters such as upload ID and part size.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new UploadState with the provided upload ID parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the upload ID parameters that uniquely identify this upload.

methods.name: setUploadId
methods.description: Sets or updates a specific component of the upload ID parameters.

methods.name: getPartSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of each upload part.

methods.name: setPartSize
methods.description: Sets the size of each upload part.

methods.name: markPartAsUploaded
methods.description: Marks a specific part as uploaded, storing its associated data.

methods.name: hasPartBeenUploaded
methods.description: Checks whether a specific part has been uploaded.

methods.name: getUploadedParts
methods.description: Returns all uploaded parts, sorted by part number.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the upload (CREATED, INITIATED, or COMPLETED).

methods.name: isInitiated
methods.description: Checks if the upload has been initiated.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the upload has been completed.
